description: Phoenix Hatchling default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/phoenix_hatchling-character-sheet.png: the five palette chips (intake.json swatches maroon 79,20,17 / orange 245,143,28 / taupe 117,87,80 / pink 232,129,122 / smoke 27,23,22) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (sampler: service venv PIL, median of a masked box per surface; boxes in each note). Glow (drawn on the sheet): the collar ring, the chest jewel and the ember flecks only; peak emission (max channel / 255 x emission_scale x material emission_strength) stays under the 2.0 phone cap.

head.note: big round head: chip 79,20,17 (x1259 y870); drawn front interior x150-260 y320-380 median 80,20,17, side 81,20,17, back 82,20,17

crest.note: curled feather crest: same maroon (front crest x185-215 y255-285 median 80,19,16); its own region so it can be nudged apart from the head

collar.note: smoky fluff collar: chip 27,23,22 (inferred by spacing, x1589 y869); drawn collar front x70-340 y515-560 (max channel < 60) median 30,25,24

smoke_light.note: the subtle dark-grey puff highlights on the collar: drawn collar boxes, pixels with max channel 40-60 and R - B < 30 (grey, not taupe): front x80-330 y518-550 median 47,37,35, side 47,37,35, back 47,37,35, SMOKE COLLAR panel 47,37,34. v1 used 97,71,66 (the thin brighter strokes + taupe bleed) and read as polka dots

body.note: small round body: chip 117,87,80 (x1423 y869); drawn belly front x180-230 y640-700 median 118,87,81, side 117,86,80

wing.note: feather-scalloped wing shapes: drawn front wing x90-140 y640-690 median 116,85,80 (same taupe)

tail.note: short tail tuft: taupe chip; the side view draws it in shade (x1110-1150 y650-680 median 105,75,69) -- drawn shading, not a separate tone

eye.note: large round glossy black eyes: drawn front eye x85-115 y390-420 (max channel < 60) median 7,6,6; glossy = the eye material's low roughness (build EYE_ROUGHNESS)

eye_hi.note: white highlight dot: drawn front x105-116 y388-398 (min channel > 200) median 242,242,242

beak.note: small orange beak: chip 245,143,28 (x1342 y869); drawn front beak median 244,142,25, side 244,143,26

ring.note: GLOWING ORANGE RING at the head base (the band of head surface where it sits into the collar): drawn front band x120-290 y488-515 (R > 180, G > 60) median 250,146,19

jewel.note: chest EMBER JEWEL (diamond): drawn front x195-216 y600-632 (R > 180) median 249,149,28

jewel_core.note: the jewel's inner red-orange diamond: drawn front x200-212 y608-625 (R > 180, G < 110) median 245,72,10

leg.note: thin pink legs + three-toed feet + back toe: chip 232,129,122 (x1506 y869); drawn front leg median 236,133,126, side 233,131,125, foot 233,130,124

leg_ring.note: the leg ring segments (drawn as dark lines across the leg): front x140-165 y745-755 (R < 170) median 67,41,40

ember.note: small ember flecks by the crest: drawn front x155-210 y175-240 (R > 190) median 247,100,15

ash.note: floating ash flecks round the collar: drawn front blobs x40-62 y460-505 (max channel < 32) median 24,19,19
